title: How Engineers Become Trusted Advisors
excerpt: Technical expertise solves problems, but trusted advisors help clients make better decisions. Learn how engineers build credibility, understand client priorities, and create lasting value beyond individual projects.
author: Brice Nelson

socialMedia.twitter: Technical expertise solves problems. Trusted advisors go further by understanding the client's world, providing candid guidance, and helping leaders make better infrastructure decisions.
socialMedia.linkedin: Technical expertise is the foundation of engineering consulting, but becoming a trusted advisor requires more. It means understanding the client's broader challenges, providing candid guidance, and helping turn technical complexity into better decisions.
